agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION (PTC)
  One West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301
  City Hall Lobby Community Room A
  May 28,2025 7:00pm

  MAY 2025 AGENDA

Members  Angela Allen, City Treasurer
Barbara Hibler, Chairperson  Destinee Wesley, Secretary
Richard Galindo, District 1  Peter Puglese, City Traffic Engineer
Kip Rudd, District 2  Diana Maximo, Parking and Traffic Department
Brett C.S. Roberts, District 3  William Thompson, Parking and Traffic Department
Lois Hale, District 4  Lieutenant David Salcedo, Police Department

Rules of Decorum
https://www.cityofinglewood.org/DocumentCenter/View/18857/2023-Rules-of-Decorum

A. OPENING CEREMONIES
1. Roll Call

B. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEMS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any item on the Agenda, may
  do so at this time.

C. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
1. Approval of the minutes for the meeting held on April 23, 2025.

D. NEW BUSINESS
1. General Plan Presnatation by Planning Manger, Bernard Mccrumby.

E. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS
2. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any other matter not connected
  with City business not elsewhere considered on the Agenda may do so at this time.

F. CHAIRPERSON AND COMMISSIONERS REMARKS
1. Members of the Parking and Traffic Commission will provide oral reports on any matter they
  consider to be of general interest to the public.

G. ANNOUNCEMENTS
1. The next Parking and Traffic Commission meeting will take place on Wednesday, June 25, 2025, at
  7:00 p.m. in the First Floor Community Room A at Inglewood City Hall, located at One Manchester
  Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301.

H. ADJOURNMENT
